name: Refresh Cook County parcel records
goal: Refresh the latest public Cook County Assessor parcel roll through the shared feed block and retain any source alerts for review.

config.template:
Cook County Assessor feed sync completed. Check its row count, changed flag, and alerts in the run output before using parcel records.

{summary}

Cook County Assessor feed sync failed. Do not use stale or incomplete records for a packet or mailing.

{summary}

acceptance.cmd: repo="${GLACIER_REPO:-$HOME/w/glacier-lean}"; if [ ! -f "$repo/ventures/property-tax/scripts/property_tax.py" ]; then repo="$(find "$HOME/w/workers" -maxdepth 5 -path '*/ventures/property-tax/scripts/property_tax.py' -print -quit)"; fi; test -n "$repo" && cd "$repo" && "${GLACIER_PYTHON:-$HOME/w/glacier-lean/.venv/bin/python}" -c "import json,os,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures'/'feeds.db'; assert p.parent.exists()"
